notes.title: Release is coming
notes.notes:
As you might know, we set the release date on 27 April 2017. That is 14 days from now. We can't wait to release the game. And you probably too, because a lot of you already added the game to wishlist. We want to thank you very much for that. We are a small team with a quite small (but gorgeous and polished) game and every single person interested in our game is important to us.

If you know anyone who you think could be interested in our game, please let him know.
You can send him trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BZHV9rV90xw
And a presskit: http://presskit.circusatos.com/sheet.php?p=UnderLeaves

Thank you all for your support!
